clauses.title: CL-D119 records the trim, the deletion, the measured total and the lowered ceiling
clauses.section: ## CL-D119 — The PR Skill is trimmed to its dispatch and the four mode references are deleted
requires: The role block's heading and its two role lines are byte-identical, because `helpers/launch.js` reads them on every gate launch
Both drivers' `CONTRACT_INPUT_FILES` name the PR Skill and the two shared references alone
The four authority files measured 74,363 bytes on this change, so the ceiling falls to 81,000 bytes on the CL-D43 terms, leaving 6,637 bytes.

clauses.title: Each record a deleted file, a removed rule or a retired guard touched carries the forward note
The #295 tests pin the deletion, the trim and the ceiling
requires: Issue #295 the PR Skill keeps only its dispatch sections, and the gate launch still reads its role block
Issue #295 the four mode references are deleted, unhashed, unmeasured and unpacked, and every test that names one is listed
Issue #295 the guards retire with their files and the ceiling falls on this change's measurement
Issue #295 CL-D119 records the change and every touched record carries its note
